name: prompt-playbook-studio
description: Eight complete first-party prompt workflows, retained MIT optimizer/compiler and optional local builder/Compass routes, with official provider-installed Prompt Engineer methods.

interface.shortDescription: Prompt craft, testing and reusable knowledge
interface.longDescription: Write, repair and test prompts that preserve the intended task, using focused methods, optional Prompt Compass workflows and selected pattern references. Turn an objective into a ready-to-use prompt. Repair a prompt from an observed failure without losing useful constraints. Build a traceable handoff brief or compare prompt behavior on meaningful cases. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. Writing a prompt does not execute the task inside it. Prompt Compass interaction gates remain in force; a pattern lookup is not a completed diagnosis or rewrite.
defaultPrompt: Improve this prompt while preserving every requirement.
Find a relevant template and adapt it to my task.
Compare these prompt versions against clear success tests.
